page.notes: The faint grey pencil mark in the right margin near the top ("aphias" or similar) is handwriting, not printed, and is left out. The marginal references "Cap.3.", "Cap.4008" and "Cap.9." are printed as shown; "Cap.4008" may be a misprint for a different number.
